newsitem.title: USA: Chevron settles Texas suit for $17.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Chevron settles Texas suit for $17.5 mln.

text.p: Chevron U.S.A. Inc agreed to pay $17.5 million and alter its system for determining royalties to settle a class-action crude oil royalty lawsuit filed in Texas, the state's General Land Office said Friday.
The settlement of a lawsuit filed by the state and joined by private leaseholders must be approved by a state district judge in Travis County, the state agency said.

The lawsuit was filed in July 1995 and alleged several Texas producers, including the Chevron Corp unit, based lease royalty payments on posted prices instead of typically higher market prices for oil lifted in the state.
